MoRTH Spec. 1500, 1600 & 1700). MoRTH Spec. 1500, 1600 & 1700). Item is inclusive of cost of cement, coarse sand, coarse aggregate (20 mm & 10 mm), admixture (for M40 and above), labour (mate, mason, mazdoor), machinery/plant (batching plant @ 20 cum/hour, transit mixer 4 cum capacity and concrete pump), overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Rate analysis is carried out for an output of 120 cum. Formwork and staging cost has been added over the basic cost of labour, material & machinery as a percentage depending on the type of super-structure element (Solid Slab Super-structure (20-30% of a+b+c for formwork)) and height of pier/support (Height above 10m).

data.name: RCC/PSC Grade M35 - Solid Slab - Height upto 5m - Case II (Batching Plant)
data.description: Furnishing and placing Reinforced/Prestressed cement concrete in super-structure of grade M35 (RCC/PSC) as per approved drawing and MoRTH Technical Specification (Ref. MoRTH Spec. 1500, 1600 & 1700). Item is inclusive of cost of cement, coarse sand, coarse aggregate (20 mm & 10 mm), admixture (for M40 and above), labour (mate, mason, mazdoor), machinery/plant (batching plant @ 20 cum/hour, transit mixer 4 cum capacity and concrete pump), overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Rate analysis is carried out for an output of 120 cum. Formwork and staging cost has been added over the basic cost of labour, material & machinery as a percentage depending on the type of super-structure element (Solid Slab Super-structure (18-28% of a+b+c for formwork)) and height of pier/support (Height upto 5m).

data.description: High tensile steel wires/strands including all accessories for stressing, stressing operations and grouting complete as per drawing and Technical Specification.

data.name: Cement Concrete Wearing Coat M-30 Grade
data.description: Providing and laying cement concrete wearing coat of M-30 grade including reinforcement complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications (Ref. MoRTH Spec. 2702). Comprises M30 grade concrete (as per Item 14.1(C), excluding formwork), HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.075 MT/cum (as per Item 14.2, excluding overheads & profit), labour for cleaning deck slab concrete surface, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 1 cum. Applied directly over the Deck Slab.

data.name: Mastic Asphalt wearing course on deck slab
data.description: Providing and laying 12 mm thick mastic asphalt wearing course on top of deck slab excluding prime coat with paving grade bitumen meeting the requirements given in table 500-29, prepared by using mastic cooker and laid to required level and slope after cleaning the surface, including providing antiskid surface with bitumen precoated fine grained hard stone chipping of 9.5 mm nominal size at the rate of 0.065 cum per 10 sqm and at an approximate spacing of 10 cm center to center in both directions, pressed when the temperature of surface not less than 100 deg. C, protruding 1 mm to 3 mm over mastic surface, all complete as per clause 515.

data.name: Precast RCC Railing (M30 Grade)
data.description: Construction of precast RCC railing of M30 grade, aggregate size not exceeding 12 mm, true to line and grade, tolerance of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical posts not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space between posts for expansion, complete as per approved drawings (MoRTH SD/202) and Technical Specifications (Ref. Clause 2703, 1500, 1600 & 1700). Includes M30 grade concrete for 28 vertical posts and 3-tier hand rails (total 4.092 cum for 48 m run), 5% additional formwork cost for casting-yard precasting, HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.865 MT, 5% cost addition for handling and fixing of precast panels, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 48 m (2 x 24 m span). Fixed on top of the Deck Slab edge.

data.name: Cast-in-situ RCC Railing (M30 Grade)
data.description: Construction of RCC railing of M30 grade in-situ with 20 mm nominal size aggregate, true to line and grade, tolerance of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical posts not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space between posts for expansion, complete as per approved drawings (MoRTH SD/202) and Technical Specifications (Ref. Clause 2703, 1500, 1600 & 1700). Includes M30 grade concrete for 28 vertical posts and 3-tier hand rails (total 4.092 cum for 48 m run), 12% additional formwork cost, HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.865 MT, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 48 m (2 x 24 m span). Fixed on top of the Deck Slab edge.

data.name: Reinforced Cement Concrete Approach Slab
data.description: Reinforced cement concrete approach slab including reinforcement and formwork complete as per drawing and Technical Specification (Ref. Clause 1500, 1600, 1700 & 2704). Comprises M30 grade concrete as per Item 12.8(G) using batching plant (excluding formwork, excluding overheads & profit) with formwork added @ 2% of cost (against 3.5% for foundation concrete), HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.05 MT/cum (as per Item 14.2, excluding overheads & profit), overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 1 cum. Grade may be adopted as M30 for severe conditions and M25 for moderate conditions. Connects to the Deck Slab at the bridge approach.

data.name: Precast Pretensioned Concrete Girders (M-40)
data.description: Providing, precasting, transportation and placing in position precast pretensioned concrete girders of M-40 grade as per drawing and Technical Specifications (Ref. Clause 1800 & 2300). Includes cement, coarse sand, coarse aggregate, admixture, HYSD steel, HT strand (with 5% wastage/anchoring allowance), LDO for steam curing, 1% consumables (binding wire, foam, packing tape, shuttering oil, HDPE pipe, bolts/nuts); labour for reinforcement cage fabrication, cable threading/prestressing/grouting, formwork erection/dismantling, concreting, steam & manual curing, handling/stacking, and placement of girders over pier caps; machinery at casting yard and for transportation/placement (generator, batching plant, transit mixer, concrete pump, crane 35T, trailer 30T, loader); 5% addition for formwork, steam curing and pretensioning arrangement; overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 1 cum.

data.description: Asphaltic Plug joint. Providing and laying of asphaltic plug joint to provide for horizontal movement of 25 mm and vertical movement of 20 mm, depth of joint varying from 75 mm to 100 mm, width varying from 500 mm to 750 mm (in traffic direction), covered with a closure plate of 200mm x 6mm of weldable structural steel conforming to IS: 2062, asphaltic plug to consist of polymer modified bitumen binder, carefully selected single size aggregate of 12.5 mm nominal size and a heat resistant foam caulking/backer rod, all as per approved drawings and specifications.

data.name: Elastomeric Slab Steel Expansion Joint (upto 50mm movement)
data.description: Providing and laying an elastomeric slab seal expansion joint catering to horizontal movement upto 50 mm, complete as per approved drawings and MoRTH specifications.

data.name: Compression Seal Joint
data.description: Providing and laying of compression seal joint consisting of steel armoured nosing at two edges of the joint gap suitably anchored to the deck concrete and a preformed chloroprene elastomer or closed cell foam joint sealer compressed and fixed into the joint gap with special adhesive binder to cater for a horizontal movement upto 40 mm and vertical movement of 3 mm.

data.name: Strip Seal Expansion Joint
data.description: Providing and laying of a strip seal expansion joint catering to maximum horizontal movement upto 70 mm, complete as per approved drawings and standard specifications to be installed by the manufacturer/supplier or their authorised representative ensuring compliance to the manufacturer's instructions for installation.

data.name: Modular Strip / Box Seal Joint (70 mm to 140 mm movement)
data.description: Modular Strip / Box Seal Joint (Providing and laying of a modular strip Box steel expansion joint including anchorage catering to a horizontal movement beyond 70 mm and upto 140mm, complete as per approved drawings and standard specifications to be installed by the manufacturer/supplier or their authorised representative ensuring compliance to the manufacturer's instructions for installation.)

data.name: Modular Strip / Box Seal Joint (140 mm to 210 mm Movement)
data.description: Modular Strip / Box Seal Joint - Providing and laying of a modular strip box seal expansion joint catering to a horizontal movement beyond 140 mm and upto 210 mm, complete as per approved drawings and standard specifications to be installed by the manufacturer/supplier or their authorised representative ensuring compliance to the manufacturer instructions for installation.

data.name: Restoration of Rain Cuts on Road Embankment/Slopes
data.description: Restoration of rain-cut damage on road embankments/slopes. The work involves clearing the affected area, benching, filling with approved soil in 150 mm layers, and compacting to match the original profile.

data.name: Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil)
data.description: Making up loss of material and correcting irregularities on the earthen shoulder by adding fresh selected soil, watering, grading, and compacting to the required camber and density.

data.name: Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil)
data.description: Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor.

data.name: Filling Pot-holes with Open-Graded Premix Surfacing (20 mm)
data.description: Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Open-Graded Premix Surfacing (20 mm) - Removal of all failed material, trimming of completed excavation to provide firm vertical faces, cleaning of surface, painting of tack coat on the sides and base of excavation as per clause 503, back filling the pot holes with hot bituminous material as per clause 504, compacting, trimming and finishing the surface to form a smooth continuous surface, all as per clause 3004.2.

data.name: Filling Pot-holes with Bituminous Concrete 40 mm (Grading I)
data.description: Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Bituminous Concrete (40 mm) for Grading I Material - Removal of failed material, trimming, tack coat, backfilling with bituminous concrete, and compaction as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Bituminous concrete, 40mm - for grading II Material
data.description: Removal of all failed material, trimming of completed excavation to provide firm vertical faces, cleaning of surface, painting of tack coat on the sides and base of excavation as per clause 503, back filling the pot holes with hot bituminous material as per clause 504, compacting, trimming and finishing the surface to form a smooth continuous surface, all as per clause 3004.2. For grading II Material. - Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Bituminous concrete, 40mm - for grading II Material

data.name: Crack Filling
data.description: Filling of crack using slow-curing bitumen emulsion and applying crusher dust in case crack is wider than 3mm.

data.name: Dusting Road Surface with Crusher Dust
data.description: Dusting Road Surface with Crusher Dust - Applying crusher dust to areas of road where bleeding of excess bitumen has occurred complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Fog Seal
data.description: Providing and applying fog seal on existing bituminous surface including cleaning the road surface and spraying bitumen emulsion complete as per technical specifications Clause 518.

data.name: Crack Prevention courses. - Stress Absorbing Membrane (SAM) crack width less than 6 mm
data.description: Providing a Stress Absorbing Membrane (SAM) treatment for pavement sections with fine cracking (crack width less than 6 mm), consisting of a rubberised/modified bitumen membrane laid to bridge and prevent reflective cracking from propagating into an overlay.

data.name: Crack Prevention courses. - Stress Absorbing Membrane (SAM) with crack width 6 mm to 9 mm
data.description: Providing a Stress Absorbing Membrane (SAM) treatment for a more advanced level of cracking, with crack widths between 6 mm and 9 mm, using a heavier membrane/binder application than the fine-crack case to resist reflective cracking.

data.name: Crack Prevention courses. - Stress Absorbing Membrane (SAM) crack width above 9 mm and cracked area above 50  per cent
data.description: Providing a Stress Absorbing Membrane (SAM) treatment for severely cracked pavement — crack width greater than 9 mm and more than 50% of the area affected — requiring the highest binder/membrane application among the SAM variants to control reflective cracking.

data.name: Crack Prevention courses. - Bitumen Impregnated Geotextile
data.description: Providing a crack-prevention interlayer using a bitumen-impregnated geotextile fabric laid over cracked pavement before overlay, to absorb stresses and delay reflective cracking through the new surface.

data.name: Slurry Seal - 5 mm thickness
data.description: Application of a slurry seal — a mixture of fine aggregate, mineral filler, bitumen emulsion and water — laid at approximately 5 mm thickness to seal a worn or raveled pavement surface and restore surface texture.

data.name: Slurry Seal - 3 mm thickness
data.description: Application of a lighter slurry seal, laid at approximately 3 mm thickness, for pavements needing a thinner surface renewal treatment than the 5 mm variant.

data.name: Slurry Seal - 1.5 mm thickness
data.description: Application of a thin slurry seal, laid at approximately 1.5 mm thickness, typically used as a minor surface-texture and minor sealing treatment on otherwise sound pavement.

data.name: Surface Dressing for maintenance works. - 19 mm nominal chipping size
data.description: Single/double surface dressing for pavement maintenance using 19 mm nominal size chippings spread and rolled over a freshly applied binder coat, to renew the wearing surface and improve skid resistance and waterproofing.

data.name: Surface Dressing for maintenance works. - 13 mm nominal size chipping
data.description: Surface dressing for pavement maintenance using a finer, 13 mm nominal size chipping in place of the 19 mm chipping, suited to sections needing a finer-textured renewed wearing surface.

data.name: Repair of Joint Grooves with Epoxy Mortar
data.description: Repair of spalled joint grooves of contraction joints, longitudinal joints and expansion joints in concrete pavements using epoxy mortar or epoxy concrete.

data.name: Repair of Old Joints Sealant
data.description: Repair of Old Joints Sealant - Removing of existing sealant and resealing with approved sealant complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Hill Side Drain Clearance
data.description: Removal of earth from the choked hill side drain and disposing it on the valley side manually. Assuming muck causing choking of drain to be 0.2 cum per metre, quantity of earth to be removed for 10 metres = 2 cum.

data.name: Land Slide Clearance in soil
data.description: Clearance of land slides in soil and ordinary rock by a bull-dozer D 80 A-12, 180 HP and disposal of the same on the valley side.

data.name: Landslide Clearance in Hard Rock Requiring Blasting
data.description: Clearing of land slide in hard rock requiring blasting for 50 per cent of the boulders and disposal of the same on the valley side.

data.name: Snow Clearance on Roads with Dozer
data.description: Snow clearance from road surface by a bull-dozer 165 Hp and disposing it on the valley side.

data.name: Snow Clearance on Roads with Snow Blowers
data.description: Snow clearance from road surface by a snow blower and disposing on the valley side.

data.name: Applying pre-packed cement based polymer mortar
data.description: Applying pre-packed cement based polymer mortar of strength 45 Mpa at 28 days for replacement of spalled concrete. Unit = sqm, assumed thickness - 10 mm.

data.name: Replacement of Damaged Mild Steel Railing
data.description: Replacement of Damaged Mild Steel Railing. Unit = RM.

data.name: Gunniting concrete surface with cement mortar
data.description: Gunniting concrete surface with cement mortar applied with compressor after cleaning surface and spraying with epoxy complete as per Technical Specification. Unit = Sq m, assuming thickness 25 mm.

data.name: Providing and inserting nipples with approved fixing compound
data.description: Providing and inserting nipples with approved fixing compound after drilling holes for grouting as per Technical Specifications, including subsequent cutting/removal and sealing of the hole as necessary of nipples after completion of grouting with Cement/Epoxy. Unit = Number.

data.name: Sealing of cracks/porous concrete by injection process through nipples/Grouting complete
data.description: Injecting cement-based grout through the pre-fixed nipples to fill and seal cracks or porous/honeycombed zones in concrete, restoring watertightness and monolithic behaviour of the member. - Sealing of cracks/porous concrete by injection process through nipples/Grouting complete as per Technical Specification.

data.name: Patching of damaged concrete surface with polymer concrete
data.description: Patching of damaged concrete surface with polymer concrete and curing compounds, initiator and promoter, available in present formulations, to be applied as per instructions of manufacturer and as approved by the Engineer. Unit = sqm, taking output = 10 sqm for an average thickness of 25 mm.

data.name: Sealing of crack / pore concrete with Epoxy Grout
data.description: Sealing of crack / pore concrete with Epoxy Grout by injection through nipples complete as per clause 2803.1. Unit = kg.

data.name: Applying epoxy mortar over leached, honeycombed and spalled concrete surface
data.description: Applying epoxy mortar over leached, honey combed and spalled concrete surface and exposed steel reinforcement complete as per Technical Specification. Unit = sqm, assume average 10 mm thickness of epoxy mortar.

data.name: Removal of defective concrete and application of shotcrete
data.description: Removal of defective concrete, cleaning the surface thoroughly, applying the shotcrete mortar mechanically with compressed air under pressure, comprising of cement, sand, coarse aggregates, water and quick setting compound in the proportion as per clause 2807.1, sand and coarse aggregate conforming to IS: 383 and table 1 of IS: 9012 respectively, water cement ratio ranging from 0.35 to 0.50, density of gunite not less than 2000 kg/cum, strength not less than 35 Mpa and workmanship conforming to clause 2807.6. Unit = sqm, taking output = 10 sqm, 40 mm average thickness.

data.name: Applying Pre-packed Cement Based Polymer Mortar for Spalled Concrete Replacement
data.description: Applying pre-packed cement based polymer mortar of strength 45 Mpa at 28 days for replacement of spalled concrete.

data.name: Epoxy bonding of new concrete to old concrete
data.description: Epoxy bonding of new concrete to old concrete. Unit = sqm.

data.name: Providing external prestressing with high tensile steel wires/strands (Span 25 m, 8 anchorages)
data.description: Providing external prestressing with high tensile steel wires/strands including drilling for passage of prestressing steel, all accessories for stressing and stressing operation and grouting complete as per drawing and Technical Specification. Span: 25 m, 4 cables, 8 anchorages (12.7mm dia strand in 12T13 system).

data.name: Providing external prestressing with high tensile steel wires/strands (Span 50 m, 8 anchorages)
data.description: Providing external prestressing with high tensile steel wires/strands including drilling for passage of prestressing steel, all accessories for stressing and stressing operation and grouting complete as per drawing and Technical Specification. Span: 50 m, 4 cables, 8 anchorages (12.7mm dia strand in 19T13 system).

data.name: Providing external prestressing with high tensile steel wires/strands (Span 100 m, 12 anchorages)
data.description: Providing external prestressing with high tensile steel wires/strands including drilling for passage of prestressing steel, all accessories for stressing and stressing operation and grouting complete as per drawing and Technical Specification. Span: 100 m, 4 cables, 12 anchorages (12.7mm dia strand in 19T13 system).

data.name: Replacement of Bearings
data.description: Replacement of Bearings complete as per Technical Specification. Unit = No. Lifting of superstructure span by jacking up from below, i.e. by placing the jacks on pier/abutment caps for span length of 30 m.

data.name: Rectification of Bearings
data.description: Rectification of Bearings as per Technical Specifications. Unit = No. Lifting of superstructure span by jacking up from below, i.e. by placing the jacks on pier/abutment caps for span length of 30 m.

data.name: Replacement of Expansion Joints complete as per drawings (Removal of old expansion joint including breaking of concrete, cutting of lugs and shifting of broken material etc.)
data.description: Replacement of Expansion Joints complete as per drawings Removal of old expansion joint including breaking of concrete, cutting of lugs and shifting of broken material etc. Unit: 1 RM. Priced on the basis of Taking output  12 RM. NOTE: The rate for the installation of new expansion joints may be taken from the chapter on superstructure. Broken concrete will have to be replaced which has been included in this analysis.

data.description: Replacement of Damaged Concrete Railing. Unit = RM.

data.name: Replacement of Crash Barrier
data.description: Replacement of Crash Barrier. Unit = RM.

data.name: Replacement of Damaged Mild Steel Railing
data.description: Replacement of damaged mild steel railing including labour for dismantling old railing and disposal of dismantled material as per drawing and technical specifications.

data.name: Repair of Crash Barrier (Repair of concrete crash barrier with cement concert of M-30 grade by cutting and trimming the damaged portion to a regular shape, cleaning the area to be repaired thoroughly, applying cement concert after erection of proper form work.)
data.description: Repair of Crash Barrier Repair of concrete crash barrier with cement concert of M-30 grade by cutting and trimming the damaged portion to a regular shape, cleaning the area to be repaired thoroughly, applying cement concert after erection of proper form work. It is assumed that damage is to the extent of 10 per cent  of the volume of concrete .This will require 0.30 cum of concrete. For dismantling and trimming the surface to a regular shape and removal of damaged material. This may be priced based on the rate given the chapter of superstructure. Unit: Running meter.. Priced on the basis of Taking output  10 M..

data.name: Repair of RCC Railing (Carrying out repair of RCC M30 railing to bring it to the original shape.)
data.description: Repair of RCC Railing Carrying out repair of RCC M30 railing to bring it to the original shape. It is assumed that damage is to the extent of 10 per cent  . For dismantling and trimming the surface to a regular shape and removal of damaged material. Unit: Running meter.. Priced on the basis of Taking output  10 M..

data.name: Repair of Steel Railing
data.description: Repair of steel railing to bring it to the original shape. It is assumed that the damage to the steel railing is to the extent of 10 per cent. Unit = Running meter, taking output = 10 M.
